content: .{@-विधातृ@} {%m.%} [अनागतम् उद्दिश्य विदधाति] one who provides for the future, provident, prudent (used as the name of a fish in <ls>Pt. 1. 318</ls>; <ls>H. 4. 6</ls>); अनागतविधाता च प्रत्युत्पन्नमतिस्तथा . द्वावेतौ सुखमेधेते यद्भविष्यो विनश्यति .. (where <ls>Dr. Peterson</ls> translates the three names by ‘<ab>Mr.</ab> Provider-against-a-future-evil’, ‘<ab>Mr.</ab> Cool-head’, and ‘<ab>Mr.</ab> what-will-be-will-be’).
